assumptions: Both arms row simultaneously and symmetrically, so laterality is bilateral.

The torso is held isometrically in a hip hinge with a neutral spine and slightly bent knees; the hips and trunk do not move during the rep, so hip extension is an assist and the spine is covered by anti_flexion_spine.
Joint actions describe the concentric pull: shoulder extension, scapular retraction and elbow flexion.
The dumbbells move freely in the hands, so the chain is classed as open_chain.
Edited by the council from revision 140dce3556ac, as the reviewer proposed: elbow_joint/flexion emphasis -> assist.
classification_reasons: Both dumbbells are held in neutral grip and rowed toward the torso while the torso stays hinged and stationary, which the vocabulary can represent.

The contact sheet matches the text: frame 1 shows the arms hanging with a flat hinged torso, and frame 2 shows both dumbbells pulled to the sides of the torso with the elbows bent and close to the body.
